title: Deep-space picture at 10x zoom, scanning alternate rows
summary: Plan a slow fixed-10x scan of the owner's unchanged 1080x1080 space picture on the 60x60 canvas: start top-left, traverse alternating rows with 10%-height descents and cover the whole image. One owner question remains: approve an extra bottom-row pass to reach the requested bottom-right endpoint, or accept the ten-row bottom-left ending. Seed and original reference only; no implementation or deployment.
